mintAuthority.headline: Issuer signing keys can mint rcUSD, raise issuance limits and replace the minting logic.
mintAuthority.summary: rcUSD native issuance uses a Sui TreasuryCap held inside shared ManagedTreasury. The sole ControllerCap holder can mint without a USDC deposit and raise the vault ceiling; the same address holds OracleCap and can create rcUSD through staking accounting reports. A separate single-signature administrator grants roles and owns the compatible-upgrade capability. Both current authorities resolve to simple secp256k1 signing addresses. No enforced economic supply bound or independent reserve-to-liability reconciliation was established. Private key custody remains undisclosed.

controls.capDescription: The vault max_supply is 25000000000000 raw units (25 million rcUSD), but this controller can replace that ceiling immediately. whitelist_vault::mint_rcusd requires no deposit; staking::handle_oracle_report independently mints positive reported interest into the rcUSDp pool without a reserve-verification check.

controls.evidence: Sui checkpoint 345646368, digest Byu8r4q2N4HWWbjK738MjiAX26SSkN1VpQ1ZTKV3JMP2, timestamp 2026-11-15T22:46:34.167Z. Checkpoint.query reads AuthInner role bag 0xd7363f95cb40c63212a30651b574853e535d06f8089259afa0a63ec8fe0652e7 with size 4 and hasNextPage=false. Its ControllerCap and OracleCap records both name this address. Exact version-1 package disassembly enforces those roles on whitelist_vault::mint_rcusd, set_max_supply and staking::handle_oracle_report. The direct mint returns newly created rcUSD after only an adjustable ceiling check; the accounting report can mint a caller-specified positive interest amount into the staking balance. At transaction C6Y8Vzcp5cvJ1Yi39CU4H5bTnUyn1D16RdHLX1pnyShP, checkpoint 345413409 (2026-11-15T07:00:18.362Z), the sender is this exact current role address and the signature scheme is Secp256K1Signature. BLAKE2b-256 over flag 1 and the signature public key reproduces the role address. This proves single-signature chain authority, not the number of people or custody devices controlling that key.

review.evidence: Sui checkpoint 345646368, digest Byu8r4q2N4HWWbjK738MjiAX26SSkN1VpQ1ZTKV3JMP2, timestamp 2026-11-15T22:46:34.167Z. All decisive state reads used Checkpoint.query and matching before/after checkpoint headers. TreasuryCap 0xed99bfb3ee72cd1eb8be16a562b1f0996a050670e227ee6ebc7b829d935fbb36 holds total_supply=18297963222105, inside ManagedTreasury 0xf6495c5c7881cc89bff7a32250edb79eaeded52d23bfecbe24746c9911fd2a5c. The exact original package contains the deposit mint, privileged vault mint, accounting-report mint/burn, controller parameter setters and administrator role setters. AuthInner has four current role records, fully paginated: one AdminCap at the administrator, ControllerCap and OracleCap at the same operational signer, and a separate AssessorCap holder 0xfd120b328b295722da159612f819ddb9aa777736a654f02380124c7ec11d37b8 that controls whitelist membership rather than arbitrary native issuance. Both effective issuance authorities are independently matched to simple signatures. The upgrade owner can replace mint logic and the operational controller can raise its own nominal cap, so an immutable collateral bound is not established. Internal accounting reports are not external reconciliation. No current independent whole-liability reconciliation or exact-token prudential-supervision evidence was established; those fields remain unknown. No negative incident-clearance claim is made.
